title: core.command.v1 HoldFunds payload
description: Reserve the debit amount and fee for a transaction that needs an external call. Needs customer authorisation: mw-auth's transaction assertion (spec 18.7, D22) with the request's idempotencyKey, which the core needs to recompute the assertion's txnHash. No PIN travels to the core since ticket 72 (the PIN scheme M11 is gone).

idempotencyKey.description: The mw.txn.request.v1 idempotencyKey; part of the assertion's txnHash.
